answer: Neighbor-quorum stops bulk fakes. Every identity posts 70 credits, gathers five neighbors, each cipher-sealing an attestation in a velvet ledger. Auditors replay each seal and trace keys; one shared key makes a hollow quorum, and all its bonds burn. First quorum 35, k-th fake 35+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,031,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors share one cipher seal, so a second identity fails; one honest quorum costs 35.
